title: A2UI surface v1 (brand-ui)
description: An agent-designed screen as data: a tree of brand-ui catalog nodes. Every `type` is a catalog entry, props are checked per type, and `on` binds catalog events to host actions. Text is a plain string child.

title.description: Accessible name of the surface region.

payload.description: Free JSON attached to the action.

size.description: Size preset. Resolves to a col + row span. Overridden by explicit `span`. @default "sm"

span.description: Explicit grid span. Wins over `size`. Spans clamp gracefully on narrow layouts — a `col: 4` on a 2-col grid becomes `span min(4, 2)`.

spotlight.description: Enable the cursor-following spotlight gradient on this tile. Omit to inherit the parent `BentoGrid`'s `spotlight` (itself `false` by default) — so the effect…

Button.description: An action. Bind `on.click`; one `variant: "default"` per group.

Card.description: The one generic surface — compose CardHeader / CardContent / CardFooter inside.

detail.description: Optional detail-panel content. **Undefined → a plain card** (today's single `<div>` — no grid, no panel, zero behaviour change).

detailLabel.description: Accessible label for the detail region. @default "Details"

detailPlacement.description: Which edge the detail panel sits on. @default "side"

detailReveal.description: `fixed` (default, accessible) → panel always visible. `hover` → hidden at rest, revealed on hover **and** keyboard `focus-within` at a FIXED outer footprint …

CardAction.description: The header's trailing action slot (a Button, a Badge).

measure.description: Cap the line length to a readable prose measure (`max-w-prose`, ~65ch) for genuine paragraph content (#339). Off by default — short, subtitle-style descripti…

Checkbox.description: Binary on/off toggle within a form (multi-select within a group).

columns.description: Number of columns at the widest breakpoint. Collapses to a single column on small screens. Default 1.

layout.description: `horizontal` places the label beside the value; `vertical` stacks the label above the value. Default `horizontal`.

label.description: The term / label for this entry.

numeric.description: When the value is numeric, set this so the value uses `tabular-nums` for aligned digits.

EmptyState.description: Nothing here yet — title, description, optional actions.

icon.description: Optional icon shown above the title, clamped to a fixed 40×40 (this wrapper only ever forwards `icon` to `StatePanel`, never `illustration` — for a larger, u…

Grid.description: Responsive CSS grid, 1–4 equal columns (collapses to one column on narrow screens).

Heading.description: Section heading; `level` sets the HTML rank (1–6), `size` the type role.

level.description: Semantic heading level — drives the rendered tag AND the default size.

Input.description: Single-line text field — the base form input.

MetricCard.description: One KPI: label, value, optional delta. Put several in a Grid.

announceLoading.description: Whether this tile announces its own `loading` state via a live region. Set to `false` when several tiles are composed inside a container that already announc…

delta.description: Signed change, e.g. "+12.4%". Direction colors it.

description.description: Secondary line under the value — sublabel / context.

evidence.description: Optional grounding footer (research 11 §B.5 KPI-3) — connects a cited figure to its source (e.g. an `EvidenceChip` from `@elabs-ai/components-ai`). Rendered …

loading.description: Loading vs ready — renders a layout-shaped skeleton (matching the real box height) instead of the value/label/delta text. Default: `false`.

positiveIsGood.description: Whether "up" is good (green) — flip for metrics where down is good.

sparkline.description: Trend slot rendered directly under the value (RM-072) — pass a `<Sparkline …/>` from `@elabs-ai/components-charts`. Hidden at `size="sm"`.

valueFormat.description: How to render a NUMERIC `value`. Default: `"compact"`. Ignored for every other `ReactNode` — a string you already formatted is rendered verbatim.

visual.description: Optional inline visual shown under the value/description.

marker.description: Reference point (0–100, same scale as `value`) — e.g. an "expected by today" pace or a target — rendered as a thin vertical tick on the track. Unset (default…

markerLabel.description: What `marker` represents (already localized by the caller — e.g. `"expected 70% by today"`). When set, it is appended to the progress bar's accessible value …

RadioGroup.description: Mutually-exclusive single choice from a small visible set.

SectionHeader.description: Title + description + optional actions above a region.

eyebrow.description: Optional element rendered above the title (eyebrow / breadcrumbs).

autoTitle.description: Auto-set a native `title` from the trigger's rendered text — but ONLY while that text is actually clipped (default `true`). Set `false` when the trigger is a…

thumbProps.description: Escape hatch spread onto the thumb LAST — for `data-*`/`style`/etc, or to deliberately override `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`/`aria-valuetext` (an explicit …

Stack.description: Vertical or horizontal flex group. The default container — put siblings in a Stack, never bare.

StatePanel.description: An empty / error / loading message panel.

icon.description: Icon shown above the title, clamped to a uniform 40×40 so mismatched glyphs stay tidy. For `"error"` defaults to a built-in warning triangle. For `"loading"`…

illustration.description: A larger illustration (one of `@elabs-ai/components-ui`'s shipped `*Illustration` components, or a consumer's own `ReactNode`) shown above the title instead …

loadingLabel.description: Accessible label for the spinner in loading state. @default "Loading…"

StatusBadge.description: A closed status vocabulary with icon + text (never colour alone).

status.description: The canonical execution status, or a mapped out-of-vocabulary one (#363).

Switch.description: Immediate on/off setting toggle (applies on change, not on submit).

Text.description: A paragraph or inline run of text with a type role and tone.

Timeline.description: Ordered status timeline from `items` (title, status, timestamp, description).
